basic_info.description: Beautifully landscaped and filled with natural light, this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath home offers comfort and convenience in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.    Features include: a brand-new electrical system for peace of mind, a designer front gate that enhances curb appeal, custom window coverings (shutters in the front, blackout shade in the back bedroom), a spa-like bathroom with modern finishes, a spacious garage, and a sunny landscaped front yard. Enjoy your morning coffee in your private backyard oasis with a serene mountain backdrop.    Prime location highlights: around the corner from Tower Burgerarguably one of the best burgers in town, minutes to Mollie Stone's Market, and a short drive to West Portal Village and Noe Valley for dining, shopping, and transit.
